units.en: ⟦0⟧ is an ⟦1⟧ that requires ⟦2⟧ to gain Vojtek as a commander. This happens upon triggering the Polish event "Wojtek Never Drops A Crate", which has 5 requirements:
Stay non-aligned (you can form any kingdom of your choice).
Don't be in a faction with ⟦0⟧ (even if they've abandoned communism). This also means you can't have them as a puppet (tested with patch 1.13.4)
Be at war with ⟦0⟧ and have a division in Latium, Abruzzo, or Tuscan
Control the ⟦0⟧ Province of Hamadan (either by you or a faction member that is also at war with italy).

Start the game with Historical AI and go down the first focuses of the monarchy path. Which king (or queen) you choose is up to you, I would advise either Friedrich Christian or Michal II. (The hidden Romanov focus branch is also a very interesting option, and, if you go with Romanovs and finish this achievement, you will later have an option to install Wojtek as your monarch.)

In the meantime start going down the economic path of the tree. You can wait with the ⟦0⟧ until the last few days of the timer, this focus adds 70 days to the timer when it is selected. So focus first on the 3rd research slot and your industry, until you have to go down that side of the economic path.
Near the end of 1937 (November/December) do the focus clamp down on Danzig and then continue down the monarchy path you've chosen.

By early 1939 you should stop building factories and instead start building forts, railways and where necessary supply hubs. Furthermore, you could start taking some of the focuses from ⟦0⟧. When ⟦1⟧ demands Danzig give it to them, but don't select the fascist option in the event that follows soon afterwards.

Shortly before or after ⟦0⟧ demands Danzig the Soviets will start justifying on you and the justification will be done between January and March 1940. By the time the justification is done, you should have 48 - 72 divisions trained and on the border with the ⟦1⟧. Which should at least have Anti-Air, Artillery and Engineer Company in them.

If you went with Friedrich, you'll also need at least 12 divisions to guard the Baltic ports against naval invasions. The Focuses ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ can help you get a few of those divisions if your manpower is (too) low. Save at least 150 ⟦2⟧ for the start of the war, so you can immediately increase your conscription law. Finally, make sure you start gaining ⟦3⟧ in time because you want to switch your doctrine to Superior Firepower and preferably unlock the first few doctrines.
When the war starts do not accept the invite to the allies.

The first part of the war with the ⟦0⟧ is about holding and fending off their naval invasions. Once you feel you have a comfortable position start taking supply hubs and surrounding divisions. Make sure to justify and declare war in ⟦1⟧ while you are at war with the ⟦2⟧, this way they'll join the Comintern. If you are too late, they might get guaranteed by the UK. But this should not matter, since you are guaranteed as well.

During your war with the ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ will declare war on the Soviets as well. This should not matter, because unless they have a border with the ⟦2⟧ there is no way for the Axis to gain more than 1% participation. However, when ⟦3⟧ does declare war on the ⟦4⟧, asks for military access from at least ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧.

When the war with the ⟦0⟧ is over, annex them. To shorten the border with the Axis you can puppet Moldova. If ⟦1⟧ is in the peace deal as well, make sure to annex Hamadan. Otherwise, move 48 divisions to the ⟦2⟧ border and the rest to the border with the Axis. Declare war (you will get embargoed by a lot of countries for this) and simply defeat them.

Now for the final part, make sure you have enough divisions to hold the Axis for around a week. Without massive losses to the ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧ army will be quite big. Build forts if you think your line is too weak to hold. Finally, since you asked and got military access to both ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧ during your war with the ⟦4⟧, you can simply walk some divisions into ⟦5⟧ and have them sit in one of the required states. They will need to be able to hold for about a week, so make sure you send enough divisions and also put a few on a port for safekeeping.
Once you declare war on ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧ is called in, the achievement should trigger after no more than 7 in-game days.
…and you get a canton, everybody gets a canton!
